chars.K: KHALIL: a 33-year-old man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide black stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.F1: FRIEND1: a chubby man wearing a green tracksuit jacket with white sleeves and black trousers.
chars.F2: FRIEND2: a thin man wearing a grey hooded parka, a black beanie and brown trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening on the terrace of a typical Casablanca neighbourhood café: KHALIL sits at a small metal table with FRIEND1 and FRIEND2, glasses of mint tea and coffee on the table, KHALIL leans back looking bored while his friends chat. Street, palm tree and white buildings behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the crowded Moroccan café at night: FRIEND1 and FRIEND2 jump up cheering at a football match on a wall TV (screen seen from the side, no readable content), while KHALIL stays seated with his chin on his hand, eyes half-closed, completely bored.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, KHALIL walks home alone through an empty narrow Casablanca street under a yellow street lamp, hands in his hoodie pocket, head down, shoulders slumped, sad and disappointed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Early morning in a small modest bedroom in Casablanca: KHALIL sits on the edge of his unmade bed, staring at the floor with an empty tired expression, an alarm clock ringing on the nightstand, grey light through the window.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: KHALIL stands alone on a rooftop terrace of a Casablanca building at sunset, leaning on the railing, looking thoughtfully into the distance over the city rooftops and satellite dishes, serious and thinking hard.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime on a busy Moroccan boulevard: KHALIL stops on the pavement and looks with curiosity at the bright windows of different shops (a music shop with guitars, a cooking school, a bookshop), one finger on his chin, starting to get interested.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: KHALIL stands at a fork in a road at golden hour on the edge of Casablanca: one path leads back to the dim old café, the other path leads toward a bright glowing unknown building. He looks toward the bright path, hesitant but hopeful.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of KHALIL in his bedroom at night, standing in front of a mirror, taking a deep breath, fists clenched with sudden determination, a small packed sports bag zipped closed on the bed behind him.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Evening, KHALIL stands in front of a big closed glass door of a mysterious building in Casablanca with bright white light shining from behind the frosted glass, his hand reaching for the door handle, nervous and excited, seen from behind at a three-quarter angle.
